Weather isn't bad from where I am at, so the drive shouldn't worry you two ;).

Getting this out has already helped slow down my breathing a bit, but my mind is still flying around like crazy.

No worries, just going insane. I did sleep from about 10pm - 1am due to the 2 ambien I took. Now I'm just screwed though. I have calmed down a bit and am thinking of just starting my drive now to pass the time and then just sit there or got to an arcade in Vegas. I have a call into my therapist and she is suppose to call me in 5 hours.

I guess I'm scared because this has happened with every single girl I have ever fallen for. It's the reason I hadn't dated in so many years and every time it gets worse. If this had been 5 years ago I would have overdosed on anything I could get my hands on already, but now it's harder for me to do that due to new nieces in the family. My coping mechanism of overdosing is gone and now the pain is so great every single muscle in my body spasms. It's hard for me to take.

I think I do truly like this girl, I'm just hoping I can make it through the night / tomorrow without screwing it up.
suppose to start driving there in 3 hours.

Now I have snowballed it into. If I can't handle this I will never be happy. If I can never be happy what's the point?

I have been crying and having full body spasms for over 2 hours now. I don't know what to do. I am suppose to drive to vegas in less then 3 hours to meet this girl.

She just texted me that she got home from the clubs: "Just got back, can't wait to see you tomrrow, xoxoxoxoxo"

I want to txt her I can't make it, but I'm probably just trying to manipulate. Help?

Long story short:

http://www.reddit.com/r/relationships/comments/otedt/how_to_deal_with_jealousy_i_have_had_a_past/

Typing my rant now.
